rule: max(current MOC balance, current delegated voting power) >= 100 MOC
evaluation_time: Latest-block on-chain values when creating a proposal; the two measures are not added together.
threshold_source: Deployed source defines 100 MOC; the operating threshold was verified without an override.
verification: AI-assisted read-only inspection of the operating backend and five matching source-file hashes. No live proposal was submitted.
